params.prompt: Continuous locked-camera close mechanical action from EXACT START frame to EXACT END hand/card pose. Astrid performs only the beginning of ONE card extraction. Her drawing fingertips travel DOWN along the front of the fixed white inclined card stack, press the exposed leading edge of a single red-backed face-down card, then pull it OUTWARD toward viewer-left/down through the LOW BLACK FRONT MOUTH over its low tray/lip, arriving at the end frame with the rear card still partly inside the mouth. Red BACK faces UP. Keep the card low near felt; no lifting above the white stack, no upright presentation, no wrist turnover yet, no complete deal or second draw. Make the down/out motion brisk and continuous within the first0.7s, then settle naturally in the exact end contact pose for the remainder of the3-second clip without releasing or moving the card again. Preserve exact Astrid identity, skin tone, hair, body proportions, black sleeves to wrists, other resting hand, original camera, table and lighting. White stack remains fixed throughout; no separate card appears on top of it. One rigid card, normal attached fingers, supported front-mouth extraction. No cuts, fades, camera movement, body stretch, additional hand or duplicate card. The original start shoe construction is authoritative; the end frame defines the low hand/card placement.
